examples.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a carpenter?
options: The carpenter can measure, cut and assemble wooden components accurately. He diagnoses mechanical faults in wooden automobiles.
The carpenter can install electrical wiring and test circuit continuity. He fits switches and maintains electrical panels.
The carpenter can measure, cut, and assemble wooden components accurately. He installs doors, windows, and furniture using hand and power tools.
examples.answer: The carpenter can measure, cut, and assemble wooden components accurately. He installs doors, windows, and furniture using hand and power tools.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a vehicle service technician?
options: The vehicle service technician can use hand tools safely and follow workshop safety rules. He prepares ingredients and follows hygiene rules.
The vehicle service technician can read technical manuals and follow work instructions carefully. He installs electrical wiring and circuit breakers in the vehicles.
The vehicle service technician can diagnose basic faults and carry out routine servicing. He services vehicles and inspects engines in the workshop.
content.answer: The vehicle service technician can diagnose basic faults and carry out routine servicing. He services vehicles and inspects engines in the workshop.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a concrete work supervisor?
options: The concrete work supervisor can read drawings and check work quality on site. He repairs engines and replaces brake components.
The concrete work supervisor can coordinate workers and plan daily tasks. He programmes steaming machines and updates software systems.
The concrete work supervisor can supervise site work and enforce safety rules. He oversees concrete mixing, pouring, and curing activities.
content.answer: The concrete work supervisor can supervise site work and enforce safety rules. He oversees concrete mixing, pouring, and curing activities.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a distribution board installer?
options: The distribution board installer can use insulated tools and follow electrical safety procedures. He prepares tools for kitchen practical sessions.
The distribution board installer can read wiring diagrams and test circuits safely. He mounts boards and connects electrical circuits.
The distribution board installer can identify electrical symbols and follow work instructions. He aligns shafts and fits bearings.
content.answer: The distribution board installer can read wiring diagrams and test circuits safely. He mounts boards and connects electrical circuits.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a machine assembly technician?
options: The machine assembly technician can use measuring tools and follow assembly drawings. He manages staff leave records and HR files.
The machine assembly technician can assemble components and check mechanical alignment. He assembles machines and aligns mechanical parts.
The machine assembly technician can work accurately and follow standard procedures. He installs lighting circuits and power sockets.
content.answer: The machine assembly technician can assemble components and check mechanical alignment. He assembles machines and aligns mechanical parts.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a bakery production assistant?
options: The bakery production assistant can measure ingredients accurately and follow hygiene rules. He repairs engines and services heavy vehicles.
The bakery production assistant can work as part of a team and follow instructions. He installs network cables and routers.
The bakery production assistant can operate mixers and follow production schedules. He prepares dough and assists in bakery production.
content.answer: The bakery production assistant can operate mixers and follow production schedules. He prepares dough and assists in bakery production.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a network support technician?
options: The network support technician can identify basic faults and follow troubleshooting steps. He lays bricks and finishes block walls.
The network support technician can use tools safely and follow safety guidelines. He operates concrete mixers on site.
The network support technician can configure devices and test network connections. He installs network cables and resolves connectivity issues.
content.answer: The network support technician can configure devices and test network connections. He installs network cables and resolves connectivity issues.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a formwork installation supervisor?
options: The formwork installation supervisor can read drawings and supervise site workers. He programs software and updates systems.
The formwork installation supervisor can enforce safety rules and manage time effectively. He installs network hardware.
The formwork installation supervisor can plan formwork activities and check alignment. He supervises formwork installation on site.
content.answer: The formwork installation supervisor can plan formwork activities and check alignment. He supervises formwork installation on site.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a cable jointing technician?
options: The cable jointing technician can use hand tools correctly and follow safety instructions. He prepares dry ingredients in the kitchen.
The cable jointing technician can read diagrams and work accurately under supervision. He assembles mechanical components.
The cable jointing technician can prepare cables and complete joints safely. He carries out cable jointing work on site.
content.answer: The cable jointing technician can prepare cables and complete joints safely. He carries out cable jointing work on site.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a maintenance fitting technician?
options: The maintenance fitting technician can identify worn parts and follow maintenance schedules. He manages HR documents.
The maintenance fitting technician can repair components and carry out routine maintenance. He services/overhauls mechanical equipment.
The maintenance fitting technician can use tools safely and follow instructions. He installs data cables and routers.
content.answer: The maintenance fitting technician can repair components and carry out routine maintenance. He services/overhauls mechanical equipment.

content.sentence: Which sentences best describe the skills and duties of a food quality control assistant?
options: The food quality control assistant can record data accurately and follow hygiene standards. He repairs engines and gearboxes.
The food quality control assistant can inspect products and check quality standards. He checks food quality during production.
The food quality control assistant can follow instructions and work carefully. He installs electrical switches.
content.answer: The food quality control assistant can inspect products and check quality standards. He checks food quality during production.
